note: Preview-only layout example for narrow screens (not a game spec, not applied to the game). x' = cx + (x - cx) * lerp(1, k, narrow), narrow = InverseLerp(referenceAspect 16:9, 4:3, aspect), applied after the right-edge follow. Units: view units at depth 1 (half height = tan25).

fields.cutOn: sleeve-cut edge pixels inside the screen, summed over all timeline samples (0 = cut never visible)
fields.cutMargin: closest approach of a sleeve cut to the screen (view units, positive = outside)
fields.pose1RightMargin: min distance from pose 1 blade/fist to the right edge (negative = overflow)
fields.pose3MainBladeVisibleMin: min share of pose-3 blade pixels on screen during the main pose-3 window (active 0.6-1)
fields.pose3MainFistInside: pose-3 fist fully on screen during the main window
fields.pose3MainTipInside: pose-3 blade tip on screen during the whole main window
fields.pose2TipCrossesCentre: pose-2 blade tip crosses the screen centre
fields.idleShift: horizontal shift of the idle knife (view units)
